instruction: Love is not a spiritual practice. It is the ultimate state of union itself. Faith and devotion are foundational stages. Love is a much higher state achieved by few. In this love, you and the Divine merge into one. All ideas of 'two' or 'one' disappear. The thinking mind falls silent. The intellect is transcended. This state is known as 'Samadhi'.
subtitle: Ramashram Satsang (Ch. Sh.)
title: The Supreme Teacher
